summary: Transparent blocks placed between bookshelves and enchanting tables negate bonuses received from bookshelves
description:
Moderator Note

Please note that this bug was only partially fixed:

While part of this bug is WAI, replaceable blocks will be allowed between the table and shelves without affecting the bonus.

slicedlime in this comment

## The Bug:

Transparent blocks placed between bookshelves and enchanting tables negate bonuses received from bookshelves.

## Steps to Reproduce:

 - Build the setup shown in the attachment below. setup.png

 - Obtain some lapis along with a diamond pickaxe.

 - Place the diamond pickaxe inside the enchanting table and take note of the enchantments available.

 - Place some carpets on top of the diamond blocks.

 - Place the diamond pickaxe inside the enchanting table.

 - Take note as to whether or not transparent blocks placed between bookshelves and enchanting tables negate bonuses received from bookshelves.

## Observed Behavior:

Transparent blocks negate bonuses received from bookshelves.

## Expected Behavior:

Transparent blocks would not negate bonuses received from bookshelves.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Build the setup shown in `setup.png`.
4. Obtain some lapis.
5. Obtain a diamond pickaxe.
6. Place the diamond pickaxe in the enchanting table and note the available enchantments.
7. Place carpets on top of the diamond blocks.
8. Place the diamond pickaxe in the enchanting table again.
9. Observe whether the carpets placed between the bookshelves and enchanting table negate the bonuses received from the bookshelves.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.4.2, 1.16.3, 1.16.4 Pre-release 1, 1.16.4 Pre-release 2, 1.16.4, 20w45a, 20w46a, 20w48a, 20w49a, 20w51a, 21w03a, 1.16.5, 21w05a, 21w05b, 21w06a, 21w07a, 21w08b, 21w11a, 21w13a, 21w14a, 21w15a, 21w16a, 21w17a, 21w19a, 21w20a, 1.17 Pre-release 1, 1.17 Pre-release 3, 1.17 Pre-release 4, 1.17 Pre-release 5, 1.17 Release Candidate 1, 1.17 Release Candidate 2, 1.17, 1.17.1 Pre-release 1, 1.17.1 Pre-release 2, 1.17.1 Pre-release 3, 1.17.1 Release Candidate 1, 1.17.1, 21w37a, 21w38a, 21w42a, 21w43a, 1.18, 1.18.1, 22w05a, 22w07a, 1.18.2 Release Candidate 1, 1.18.2, 22w16b, 1.19 Pre-release 3, 1.19, 1.19.1, 1.19.2, 22w43a, 1.19.3, 23w05a, 1.19.4, 23w12a (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior:
When a transparent, non-replaceable block is placed in the space between the enchanting table and nearby bookshelves, the enchanting table treats the bookshelf path as obstructed. The bookshelves are therefore not counted, and the table offers lower-level enchantments than it does with an unobstructed path.

This issue was only partially fixed: replaceable blocks, such as carpets, are now allowed in the space between the enchanting table and bookshelves without preventing the bookshelf bonus. Non-replaceable blocks in that space continue to block the bonus.
Expected Behavior: Replaceable blocks, such as carpets, placed between bookshelves and an enchanting table should not negate the bookshelves’ enchanting bonuses. The available enchantments should remain consistent with the unobstructed setup when these blocks are added. Transparent blocks that are not replaceable may continue to prevent the bonus as intended.
